envelope.description: Apply the gate to the modifying step phases

body.title: Apply the gate to the modifying step phases
body.summary: Apply the gate to the phases of the workflow, build, review and code-review steps that t1 marked modifying: the first phase names its repo, a later phase takes the repo its run token recorded and the gate checks it is registered, and a token with no repo is refused. Update the tests of the step handlers.
acceptanceChecks: a modifying step phase with no repo and no token is refused
a later phase cannot be redirected to another repository by a repo param that differs from the token's
read-only step phases keep the session-aware resolution

tests.name: step-repo-gate.test.ts: a modifying step phase with no repo and no token is refused, and a later phase cannot be redirected to another repository by a different repo
